On 5 October 2020, Ambazonian separatists seized 15 commercial motorcycles and burnt a vehicle in Eyumojock town (Manyu, Sud-Ouest), in an attempt to block the starting of the academic year in the division. No fatality and/or casualty reported.

On 14 July 2022, soldiers on transit fired several gunshots while passing through Bamessing (Tubah, Mezam, Nord-Ouest) after they suspected the presence of separatist fighters in the general area. No casualties was reported.

On 20 September 2024, Multinational Joint Task Force clashed and repelled an attack from Boko Haram (JAS) (likely) militants in Amchide (Kolofata, Mayo-Sava Extreme-Nord). The militants claimed to have killed 1 soldier. Some sources say the militants were dressed in hijabs while others say they were in military uniforms.

Around 12 April 2024 (as reported), ISWAP or Boko Haram militants clashed with the gendarmerie forces in Hile Alifa (Hile-Alifa, Logone-et-Chari, Extreme-Nord). There were no fatalities. No information on the injuries. 5 motorbikes were stolen and property was damaged.

On 13 October 2024, ISWAP or Boko Haram militants ambushed and clashed with the military forces in Bama (Vele, Mayo-Danay, Extreme-Nord). 1 militant was killed. The military recovered 48 rounds of 7.62 mm special ammunition.
On 22 February 2021, the military forces repelled an attack of Boko Haram in Baba-Simon village, Mora subdivision (Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord). One soldier and one civilian were killed.

On 28 July 2024, Ambazonian Separatists shot and injured the Deputy Mayor of Oku in the hip in Elak (Oku, Bui, Nord-Ouest). The Separatists had taken her out during a church service before shooting at her. It was the third attempt on her life in less than a year.
Around 3 August 2022, the Cameroonian military forces raided Kokkaka village, coded to Konye (Konye, Meme, Sud-Ouest) and arrested several civilians. They were in search for separatists.
On 22 October 2023, state security forces (coded as military) shot and injured a man in Mamfe (Manyu, Sud-Ouest) when he attempted to escape after being stopped. They took him to a health facility.

Around 28 August 2022, the Ambazonian separatists attacked gendarmerie forces in Eyumojock (Eyumodjock, Manyu, Sud-Ouest). Prior to the attack, the Gendarmerie Brigade had been warned of a possible attack. Separatists also fired rockets at a military armored vehicle in Ngokuv and Dzekwa villages (coded separately). 3 Cameroonian soldiers were killed in the two events. Fatalities are split across two events.
Looting: On 17 May 2024, Ambazonian Separatists seized the motorcycle of a men in Njap (Nkambe, Donga-Mantun, Nord-Ouest) for defying the lockdown against the National Day celebrations.

On 11 April 2024, security forces, coded as the military forces ambushed Ambazonian Separatists in Awing (Santa, Mezam, Nord-Ouest) during an operation to dislodge Separatists in the area. 1 Separatist was killed.
On 23 September 2021, Ambazonian separatists attacked a prison in Kumbo town (Bui, Nord-Ouest), killing one soldier and injuring several others.

On 10 October 2024, the military forces from the Rapid Intervention shot and killed 1 civilian in Kikaikom (Kumbo, Bui, Nord-Ouest) after they extracted him from his private residence. The reason is unknown. The military forces also arrested some 50 civilians for an unknown reason.

On 25 October 2022, military forces shot and killed 4 male civilians, dumping their bodies around the Bafut forest near Bafut (Mezam, Nord-Ouest). The circumstances surrounding the killing are unknown.
On 9 May 2023, Bamenda-based journalists protested in Bamenda (Bamenda 1, Mezam, Nord-Ouest) calling for justice following the killing of journalist Anye Nde Nsoh.
Looting: On 8 October 2024, Ambazonian Separatists extorted an undisclosed amount of money from civilians at an illegal checkpoint in Ngyenmbo (Mbengwi, Momo, Nord-Ouest).
Around 14 June 2024 (as reported), Ambazonian Separatists clashed with the military forces in Mundemba (Mundemba, Ndian, Sud-Ouest). Casualties unknown.

On 4 July 2021, the army's rapid intervention force repelled an attack of ISWAP fighters in Kerawa village, Kolofata subdivision (Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord) leading to the death of 3. Some were also injured. The fighters stole weapons and ammunition.
On 16 January 2024, Ambazonian Separatists detonated a roadside IED few meters away from a military checkpoint in Nkwen (Bamenda - Nkwen, Bamenda 3, Mezam, Nord-Ouest). No casualties.

On 18 May 2024, Boko Haram (JAS) (likely) militants attacked and injured a civilian in Igawa Doulo (Mora, Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord). The injured was a mechanic. The driver and a civilian occupant escaped without injuries. There were no fatalities.
On 9 May 2022, suspected Ambazonian Separatist fighters abducted a businessman from a drinking spot in Muea (Buea, Fako, Sud-Ouest). He was released the following day after he paid a ransom fee.

On 12 August 2024, Ambazonian Separatists from the Restoration Forces faction abducted a businessman from his private residence in Bakwelle (Mamfe, Manyu, Sud-Ouest). The Separatists accused the civilian of selling Separatist-banned Brasseries brewery products. He was released after paying approximately 500,000 Franc CFA.

On 11 May 2022, the military forces fired several gunshots from their base at suspected Ambazonian Separatist fighters at the Hospital round about Bamenda (Bamenda 1, Mezam, Nord-Ouest). There were no fatalities.
On 21 February 2023, ISWAP or Boko Haram fighters abducted 3 civilians traveling on a canoe from Darak (Darak, Logone-et-Chari, Extreme-Nord).
On 18 February 2023, Ambazonian Separatists detonated an IED in Old Town in Bamenda (Mezam, Nord-Ouest) targeting state forces members (coded as military). Casualties unknown.
On 2 February 2021, suspected Boko Haram fighters kidnapped an ex-MP in his farm in Laggaye village, assumedly Laggaye 1 (Mayo-Rey, Nord).
Looting: On 17 April 2024, Boko Haram (JAS) (likely) militants looted 3 motorbikes and fired warning shots around Walassa public school in Walassa (Kolofata, Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord).

On 26 August 2022, ISWAP or Boko Haram fighters clashed with the Cameroonian military forces by the Sansani IDP camp in Gambarou (Makary, Logone-et-Chari, Extreme-Nord). The clash led to the death of 7 fighters.

On 22 February 2023, Ambazonian Separatists from the Restoration Forces faction shot and killed a civilian in Ballin (Akwaya, Manyu, Sud-Ouest). The Separatists abducted another civilian after accusing him of collaborating with the military forces to locate their hideouts. They also set fire to a shop.
Looting: On 30 October 2023, suspected Boko Haram (JAS) (likely) militants looted bean harvester from women in Doulo (Mora, Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord).
Looting: On 28 January 2022, Boko Haram (JAS) fighters looted Limani village town, Mora subdivision (Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord). They took away foods, clothes, phones and money from civilians.

Defusal: On 3 May 2024, the Rapid Intervention Battalion, with the help of the population, discovered and defused an IED planted by suspected by Ambazonian Separatists in Ndu (Ndu, Donga-Mantung, Nord-Ouest).
On 29 February 2020, the Ambazonian separatist attacked and burnt an interurban bus in Santa town (Mezam, Nord-Ouest). They accuse the bus company of not respecting the lockdown.

On 30 November 2023, the Ambazonian Restoration Forces kidnapped an unspecified number of civilians from their private residences in Bole Bakundu (Kumba 1, Meme, Sud-Ouest). The accused the civilians of not paying the annual levy imposed by the ARF.

Property destruction: On 19 January 2022, Boko Haram (JAS) (likely) fighters looted civilians and destroyed 8 houses in Zamguia neighborhood of Ashigashiya town, Mayo-Moskota subdivision (Mayo-Tsanaga, Extreme-Nord). They took away eight sheep and one cow.
On 15 October 2023, Ambazonian Separatists from SOCADEF abducted the youth president of the community from his home in Makobe (Meme, Sud-Ouest) for unknown reason. No additional information.
On 6 April 2022, Ambazonian Separatists abducted anti-separatist protesters in Oku (Bui, Nord-Ouest). They protested against the ills committed by the Ambazonian Separatists.

Looting: On 28 February 2023, Ambazonian Separatists seized a local NGO's vehicle from the driver on Fon Street in Bamenda (Mezam, Nord-Ouest) and drove away to an unknown location while firing gunshots in the air.
On 8 June 2023, the Ambazonian Separatists fighter clashed with the gendarmerie officers in Bamenda (Bamenda 1, Mezam, Nord-Ouest). A gendarmerie commander was killed.

On 27 September 2024, Boko Haram (JAS) (likely) militants abducted 3 girls working in the field in Bornori (Kolofata, Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord). The military forces found the girls in the evening without clashes.

Looting: On 2 April 2024, Ambazonian Separatists from the Restoration Forces faction forcibly collected an unspecified amount of money from 19 employees of PAMOL along a secondary road in Mundemba (Mundemba, Ndian, Sud-Ouest).
